title: Inference for Sharp Two-Period Sequential Sensitivity Endpoints at Ties

proof_attempt_summary: The run derived the nested-CDF representation, a five-component canonical gradient, a conditional cross-fitted expansion, finite-face directional geometry, and fixed-cell honest projection inference. Independent repair review validated unrestricted-QMD continuity using only base-law overlap and established a concrete clipped empirical-cell learner class. The package remained subfield-level because general-covariate learner attainability, continuous-history wall-uniform inference, and certified calibration gains remain open.
tldr: Tan's primary two-period model defines the static \((1,1)\) sharp endpoint under terminal-outcome consistency, pointwise positivity, ratio ranges, and coupled normalizations. On the bounded-outcome, uniformly overlapping subclass, its exact nested-CDF representation identifies the endpoint. At a fixed null-wall law, a declared product \(L^2\) conditional-function tangent topology suffices for the five-component gradient and efficiency bound; cross-fitting has a pointwise expansion under explicit nuisance-product, cutoff-modulus, and score-stability rates. Null walls imply \(\omega_j(\delta)\to0\), with no quantitative rate by themselves. Positive fixed-alphabet models separate ordinary atoms from genuine gap walls and yield branchwise directional and drift-dependent local limits. Multinomial confidence-region projection gives conservative finite-sample coverage across walls. Tan's Proposition 2 gives the same primary and joint sharp endpoint. The weakest general-covariate topology, attainable learner rates, continuous-history wall-uniform inference, and improved certified calibration remain open.
gap: Tan proves population sharpness but, in Section 3.2 immediately after Proposition 1 and equation (21), explicitly leaves further sample-estimation development for future work. BonviniKennedyVenturaWasserman2022 is the closest longitudinal inference comparator, but its propensity-, outcome-, and subset-confounding models for marginal structural models are not Tan's primary sequential counterfactual-outcome ratio model and do not identify this sharp endpoint. Single-period sensitivity-bound efficiency results do not iterate automatically through the second propensity, the intermediate transition, and two nested CDF kinks. Generic directional theory does not identify which optimizer ties survive projection onto the observed tangent space.
fill: Prove the CDF/check-loss equivalence; establish the conditional-function regular theorem, canonical gradient, efficiency bound, and exact cross-fitted expansion; complete the finite-alphabet face geometry and local experiments; then use exact projection as an honest baseline and investigate certified endpoint-specific improvements.
